description: A button with a primary action and a button that opens a menu of related actions.

props.icon: Turns the primary action into an icon button showing this icon.
props.menu: Controls whether the menu is open (v-model:menu).
props.menuIcon: Icon of the menu button. Rotates while the menu is open.
props.menuLabel: Accessible label of the menu button.
props.loading: Puts the primary action into a loading state. Accepts a color for the loader.

events.click: Emitted when the primary action is clicked.
